opportunities.title: Supply hard-cap invariant: assert 21M DERO ceiling at coinbase verification
opportunities.summary: ## Summary **Adds a consensus supply hard-cap invariant** asserting DERO's 21M-DERO ceiling at coinbase verification. ## The finding `Verify_Transaction_Coinbase` was an `IsCoinbase()`-only no-op. The 21M hard cap (the Bitcoin-parallel supply ceiling) was **not enforced anywhere in consensus** — the `deroHardCapAtomic` constant in `proof/proof_validation.go` only sanity-checks individual proof amounts, never chain supply. The coinbase mint (`full_reward := base_reward + fees`) had no overflow guard. DERO's emission curve is a pure function of height (`CalcSupply`) that converges to **~20.89M DERO**, so the real curve never approaches the cap — but there is no invariant that would catch a *regression* in `CalcBlockReward` / `BaseReward` / `PREMINE` (a bad `>>` shift, an accidental reward inflation, uint64 wraparound) that would silently mint past the cap. ## The change 1. **`config.MAX_SUPPLY = 21_000_000 * 100_000`** — the hard cap (2.1e12 atomic). 2. **`Verify_Transaction_Coinbase` asserts `CalcSupply(height) <= MAX_SUPPLY`** — every node recomputes the supply identically, so this is deterministic and only trips on a curve regression. Purely a defensive invariant on the real curve

opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
